title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: protect files in excluded Windows folders
summary: The rollout, opt-in requirement, client prerequisite, licensing and existing exclusion controls are supported. Minor corrections are needed: cite the application-storage source and remove checklist steps whose policy and monitoring controls are not represented in the table.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft plans Endpoint DLP protection for files in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData.
claims.quote: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData.

claims.where: front matter: status; What's changing
claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; What's changing

claims.quote: "targetDate": "February CY2027"

claims.where: front matter: releasePhase; What's changing
claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Open questions

claims.where: front matter: previewDate
claims.claim: The roadmap record supplies no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.where: What's changing

claims.where: What's changing; Scope

claims.quote: expect to complete by mid-March 2027 (previously end of December).

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The previous rollout start target was mid-December.
claims.quote: late February 2027 (previously mid-December)

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The previous rollout completion target was the end of December.

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: The supplied notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.where: Scope; What's changing; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The notice concerns admins and users in organisations using Endpoint DLP on Windows devices.
claims.quote: Who is affected: Admins and users in organizations that use Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) on Windows devices

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Policy checks on protected excluded files cover copying, including copying to removable media.
claims.quote: Users in block mode will be prevented from performing restricted actions (for example, copying to removable media, uploading to cloud services, or printing)

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Policy checks on protected excluded files cover printing.
claims.quote: policy checks will apply during key egress actions, including copying, printing, saving to network shares, and uploading to cloud services

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Policy checks on protected excluded files cover saving to network shares.
claims.quote: policy checks will apply during key egress actions, including copying, printing, saving to network shares, and uploading to cloud services

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Policy checks on protected excluded files cover uploading to cloud services.
claims.quote: policy checks will apply during key egress actions, including copying, printing, saving to network shares, and uploading to cloud services

claims.where: What's changing
claims.claim: In audit mode the user's action continues.
claims.quote: Users in audit mode can continue their actions, which will be logged for review.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Audit mode logs user actions involving sensitive files in protected excluded paths.
claims.quote: Audit mode logging will capture user actions involving sensitive files in protected excluded paths for review and analysis.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Block mode prevents restricted actions on protected excluded files.
claims.quote: Users in block mode will be prevented from performing restricted actions

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Where audit and block policies both apply to a user, block takes precedence.
claims.quote: If both audit and block policies apply to a user, block takes precedence

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The new protection requires administrator configuration, so its default state is admin-opt-in.
claims.quote: Admins must review excluded Windows folder paths and update Endpoint DLP policies to enable protection for files stored in excluded folders.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Devices require Microsoft Defender anti-malware client version 4.18.26051 or later.
claims.quote: Microsoft Defender anti-malware client version 4.18.26051 or later required

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The required anti-malware client must be deployed before enabling the feature.
claims.quote: Before enabling this feature, you must first deploy anti-malware Client version 4.18.26051 or later

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft asks admins to review excluded paths for sensitive files and identify paths for the protected exclusion paths list.
claims.quote: Review excluded folder paths: Identify which excluded paths (such as AppData and temporary directories) contain or could contain sensitive files and should be added to the protected exclusion paths list.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft asks admins to extend existing Endpoint DLP policies to cover protected excluded folders where applicable.
claims.quote: Update DLP policies: Extend existing Endpoint DLP policies to cover protected excluded folders where applicable.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends starting with an audit-mode pilot before enforcement.
claims.quote: Stage your rollout: Start with an audit-mode pilot to assess impact before enabling enforcement.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends educating users and support teams about potentially blocked actions.
claims.quote: Educate users and support teams: Inform them of expected behavior changes, including potentially blocked actions such as copy, print, or upload operations.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Under the existing exclusion mechanism, files created or modified in excluded locations are not subject to Endpoint DLP policy enforcement.
claims.quote: Any files that you create or modify in those locations aren't subject to DLP policy enforcement.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Files in locations excluded by the existing mechanism are not audited.
claims.quote: Files in excluded locations aren't audited.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Learn lists two AppData paths as excluded by default.
claims.quote:
#### Windows file paths excluded by default

- `%SystemDrive%\\Users\\*(1)\\AppData\\Roaming`
- `%SystemDrive%\\Users\\*(1)\\AppData\\Local`

claims.where: Why it matters
claims.claim: Applications store data in application-data and temporary folders.
claims.quote: The folders where your app can store data. These folders (local, roaming and temporary) are created when your app is installed.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/apps/develop/files/file-access-permissions to sources for the application-storage premise in 'Users and applications write to AppData and temporary folders'.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The published feature description describes no change to identity or permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Endpoint DLP configure endpoint settings permissions roles Compliance Administrator excluded folder protection'; read MC1384420 and Configure endpoint data loss prevention settings. Neither describes a new identity or permission mechanism for this feature.

claims.where: controls[0]; What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not yet document the UI path or automation operation enabling protection for excluded Windows folders.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "protect"', '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded" "Set-PolicyConfig"', '"Endpoint DLP" "protected exclusion"'; opened Configure endpoint data loss prevention settings and Set-PolicyConfig. Only the existing exclusions are documented.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Open questions
claims.claim: The configuration scope of the new protected-exclusion setting is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "scope" "roles"'; read MC1384420, Configure endpoint data loss prevention settings and policy-scoping search excerpts. None states the scope of the new protected-exclusion setting.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls; Scope
claims.claim: The existing exclusion list is at Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Overview > Data loss prevention settings > Endpoint settings > File path exclusions for Windows.
claims.quote: go to [Microsoft Purview portal](https://purview.microsoft.com) > **Data loss prevention** > **Overview** > **Data loss prevention settings** > **Endpoint settings** > **File path exclusions for Windows**.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-PolicyConfig -EndpointDlpGlobalSettings @(@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="<path>"}) configures an existing path exclusion.
claims.quote:
Example values:

- `@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="C:\Windows";}`
- `@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="%AppData%\Mozilla";}`
- `@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="C:\Users\*\Desktop";}`

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope
claims.claim: Set-PolicyConfig is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.where: controls[1].scope
claims.claim: The existing file path exclusion settings are tenant-level settings applying across DLP policies for devices.
claims.quote: Centrally configured settings control many aspects of endpoint data loss prevention (DLP) behavior. These settings apply to all DLP policies for devices.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Endpoint DLP is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW, Defender + Purview Suite FLW and Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance.
claims.quote:
Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) | Included |

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: No additional licence specific to the excluded-folder protection change has been published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "license" "billing"'; opened the Purview service description and billing-models page; read the roadmap and MC1384420. General Endpoint DLP entitlement is published, but no additional change-specific licence is stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No meter is documented specifically for this change.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "license" "billing"'; opened Learn about Microsoft Purview billing models and Microsoft Purview service description. Neither lists a meter for protecting excluded Windows folders.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes
claims.claim: Purview's per-user licensing model covers controls and protections for Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.
claims.quote: This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.

claims.where: Scope
claims.claim: Microsoft has not yet published which administrator roles configure the new protected-exclusion setting.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Endpoint DLP configure endpoint settings permissions roles Compliance Administrator excluded folder protection' and '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "scope" "roles"'; read MC1384420 and the endpoint-settings page. No role for the new setting is named.

claims.where: Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The interaction between the new setting and edits to the existing exclusion list is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Endpoint DLP" "protected exclusion"' and '"Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "scope" "roles"'; read MC1384420 and Configure endpoint data loss prevention settings. Neither explains the interaction of the two lists.
